title: Algebraic Fractions and Partial Fractions
seo_title: Year 13 A Level Maths: Partial Fractions Worksheets
standard_text: Simplify rational expressions, including by factorising and cancelling, and algebraic division; decompose rational functions into partial fractions (denominators not more complicated than squared linear terms).
meta_desc: Free Year 13 A level maths worksheets on algebraic fractions and partial fractions: simplifying, multiplying, dividing and adding algebraic fractions and splitting into partial fractions. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: A/(x + a) + B/(x + b): substitute x = −a and x = −b.
key_sub: Factorise first, then cancel common factors.
body_html:
How it works

To split (px + q)/((x + a)(x + b)), write A/(x + a) + B/(x + b), multiply through by the denominator and substitute values of x that make a bracket zero.

Example

(5x + 1)/((x − 1)(x + 2))

5x + 1 = A(x + 2) + B(x − 1)

x = 1: A = 2; x = −2: B = 3

Answer: 2/(x − 1) + 3/(x + 2)

Common mistakes

  • Cancelling terms instead of factors.
  • Substituting the wrong value to find A.
  • Sign errors when the bracket is (x − a).

faq.q: How do you find partial fractions?
faq.a: Write the fraction as A/(first factor) + B/(second factor), multiply both sides by the denominator, then substitute values that make each bracket zero.
They make expressions easier to integrate and to expand as series.

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² + 8x + 7x² − 5x − 6?
items.e: Factorise the denominator: (x + 1)(x − 6). It is 0 at both values, even though (x + 1) cancels with the numerator. x = −1 and x = 6.
Factorise: (x + 3)(x − 6)(x + 3)(x + 4). Cancel the common factor (x + 3): x − 6x + 4, with x ≠ −3, −4. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)
Factorise: (x + 7)(x + 4)(x + 7)(x − 5). Cancel the common factor (x + 7): x + 4x − 5, with x ≠ −7, 5. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² − 6x + 8x² − 3x − 4?
items.e: Factorise the denominator: (x − 4)(x + 1). It is 0 at both values, even though (x − 4) cancels with the numerator. x = −1 and x = 4.
Factorise: (x + 7)(x − 1)(x + 7)(x − 3). Cancel the common factor (x + 7): x − 1x − 3, with x ≠ −7, 3. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² − 3x − 4x² + 6x + 5?
items.e: Factorise the denominator: (x + 1)(x + 5). It is 0 at both values, even though (x + 1) cancels with the numerator. x = −5 and x = −1.

items.q: Simplify x² − 10x + 21x + 7 ÷ x² − 5x − 14x + 7.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 7)(x − 3)x + 7 · x + 7(x − 7)(x + 2). Factorise and cancel (x − 7) and (x + 7): x − 3x + 2.

items.q: Simplify x² − 3x − 4x + 4 ÷ x² − 5x + 4x + 4.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 4)(x + 1)x + 4 · x + 4(x − 4)(x − 1). Factorise and cancel (x − 4) and (x + 4): x + 1x − 1.

items.q: Simplify x² − 2x − 8x − 3 ÷ x² − 16x − 3.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 4)(x + 2)x − 3 · x − 3(x − 4)(x + 4). Factorise and cancel (x − 4) and (x − 3): x + 2x + 4.

items.q: Simplify x² − 7x + 12x² − 11x + 30 · x − 6x − 3.
items.e: Factorise: (x − 3)(x − 4)(x − 6)(x − 5) · x − 6x − 3. Cancel (x − 3) and (x − 6): x − 4x − 5.

items.q: Simplify x² + 7x + 10x² + x − 30 · x + 6x + 2.
items.e: Factorise: (x + 2)(x + 5)(x + 6)(x − 5) · x + 6x + 2. Cancel (x + 2) and (x + 6): x + 5x − 5.

items.q: Simplify x² + 2x − 8x² + 3x − 18 · x − 3x + 4.
items.e: Factorise: (x + 4)(x − 2)(x − 3)(x + 6) · x − 3x + 4. Cancel (x + 4) and (x − 3): x − 2x + 6.

items.q: Simplify x² + 13x + 42x + 4 ÷ x² − 49x + 4.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x + 7)(x + 6)x + 4 · x + 4(x + 7)(x − 7). Factorise and cancel (x + 7) and (x + 4): x + 6x − 7.

items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 5)(x − 3)x + 3 · x + 3(x − 5)(x + 4). Factorise and cancel (x − 5) and (x + 3): x − 3x + 4.

items.e: Factorise: (x + 2)(x + 6)(x − 5)(x − 4) · x − 5x + 2. Cancel (x + 2) and (x − 5): x + 6x − 4.

items.e: Factorise: (x − 2)(x + 1)(x − 1)(x + 7) · x − 1x − 2. Cancel (x − 2) and (x − 1): x + 1x + 7.

items.q: Simplify x² + 9x + 18x − 4 ÷ x² + 7x + 6x − 4.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x + 6)(x + 3)x − 4 · x − 4(x + 6)(x + 1). Factorise and cancel (x + 6) and (x − 4): x + 3x + 1.

items.q: Simplify x² − 36x² − 2x − 15 · x + 3x − 6.
items.e: Factorise: (x − 6)(x + 6)(x + 3)(x − 5) · x + 3x − 6. Cancel (x − 6) and (x + 3): x + 6x − 5.

items.e: Factorise: (x + 6)(x + 4)(x + 5)(x − 1) · x + 5x + 6. Cancel (x + 6) and (x + 5): x + 4x − 1.

items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 2)(x − 3)x − 6 · x − 6(x − 2)(x − 4). Factorise and cancel (x − 2) and (x − 6): x − 3x − 4.

items.q: Simplify 3xx + 6 − 9xx + 6.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: −6xx + 6. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 6x + 6 + 1x − 4.
items.e: LCD = (x + 6)(x − 4). Rewrite: 6(x − 4)(x + 6)(x − 4) + 1(x + 6)(x + 6)(x − 4). Combine the numerators: 6(x − 4) + 1(x + 6) = 7x − 18. 7x − 18(x + 6)(x − 4).

items.q: Simplify 6x − 5 − 6x + 7.
items.e: LCD = (x − 5)(x + 7). Rewrite: 6(x + 7)(x − 5)(x + 7) − 6(x − 5)(x − 5)(x + 7). Combine the numerators: 6(x + 7) − 6(x − 5) = 72. 72(x − 5)(x + 7).

items.q: Simplify 8xx − 1 + 8xx − 1.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 16xx − 1. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 2x − 6 + 3x − 5.
items.e: LCD = (x − 6)(x − 5). Rewrite: 2(x − 5)(x − 6)(x − 5) + 3(x − 6)(x − 6)(x − 5). Combine the numerators: 2(x − 5) + 3(x − 6) = 5x − 28. 5x − 28(x − 6)(x − 5).

items.q: Simplify 3x − 7 + 4x + 7.
items.e: LCD = (x − 7)(x + 7). Rewrite: 3(x + 7)(x − 7)(x + 7) + 4(x − 7)(x − 7)(x + 7). Combine the numerators: 3(x + 7) + 4(x − 7) = 7x − 7. 7x − 7(x − 7)(x + 7).

items.q: Simplify 2x + 4 + 6x − 3.
items.e: LCD = (x + 4)(x − 3). Rewrite: 2(x − 3)(x + 4)(x − 3) + 6(x + 4)(x + 4)(x − 3). Combine the numerators: 2(x − 3) + 6(x + 4) = 8x + 18. 8x + 18(x + 4)(x − 3).

items.q: Simplify 3x − 6 − 6x + 1.
items.e: LCD = (x − 6)(x + 1). Rewrite: 3(x + 1)(x − 6)(x + 1) − 6(x − 6)(x − 6)(x + 1). Combine the numerators: 3(x + 1) − 6(x − 6) = −3x + 39. −3x + 39(x − 6)(x + 1).

items.q: Simplify 6xx + 3 − 8xx + 3.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: −2xx + 3. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 9xx − 7 − 6xx − 7.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 3xx − 7. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 3x + 5 − 5x − 7.
items.e: LCD = (x + 5)(x − 7). Rewrite: 3(x − 7)(x + 5)(x − 7) − 5(x + 5)(x + 5)(x − 7). Combine the numerators: 3(x − 7) − 5(x + 5) = −2x − 46. −2x − 46(x + 5)(x − 7).

items.q: Simplify 5xx − 6 + 7xx − 6.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 12xx − 6. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify xx − 4 + 6xx − 4.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 7xx − 4. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 6x + 6 − 4x + 4.
items.e: LCD = (x + 6)(x + 4). Rewrite: 6(x + 4)(x + 6)(x + 4) − 4(x + 6)(x + 6)(x + 4). Combine the numerators: 6(x + 4) − 4(x + 6) = 2x. 2x(x + 6)(x + 4).

items.q: Simplify 1x − 4 + 4x + 3.
items.e: LCD = (x − 4)(x + 3). Rewrite: 1(x + 3)(x − 4)(x + 3) + 4(x − 4)(x − 4)(x + 3). Combine the numerators: 1(x + 3) + 4(x − 4) = 5x − 13. 5x − 13(x − 4)(x + 3).

items.q: Simplify xx + 4 + 8xx + 4.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 9xx + 4. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 5x − 2 + 6x − 6.
items.e: LCD = (x − 2)(x − 6). Rewrite: 5(x − 6)(x − 2)(x − 6) + 6(x − 2)(x − 2)(x − 6). Combine the numerators: 5(x − 6) + 6(x − 2) = 11x − 42. 11x − 42(x − 2)(x − 6).

items.q: Simplify 1x − 1 − 5x − 2.
items.e: LCD = (x − 1)(x − 2). Rewrite: 1(x − 2)(x − 1)(x − 2) − 5(x − 1)(x − 1)(x − 2). Combine the numerators: 1(x − 2) − 5(x − 1) = −4x + 3. −4x + 3(x − 1)(x − 2).

items.q: Simplify 6x + 1 − 4x − 1.
items.e: LCD = (x + 1)(x − 1). Rewrite: 6(x − 1)(x + 1)(x − 1) − 4(x + 1)(x + 1)(x − 1). Combine the numerators: 6(x − 1) − 4(x + 1) = 2x − 10. 2x − 10(x + 1)(x − 1).

items.q: Simplify 5x + 2 + 1x + 1.
items.e: LCD = (x + 2)(x + 1). Rewrite: 5(x + 1)(x + 2)(x + 1) + 1(x + 2)(x + 2)(x + 1). Combine the numerators: 5(x + 1) + 1(x + 2) = 6x + 7. 6x + 7(x + 2)(x + 1).
